description: Land Acquisition - Karagoda Uyangoda, East, Kamburupitiya D/S Division, Matara District - Errata, Extraordinary Gaz. No. 2332/42 dated 19.05.2023 Hatispattuwa D/ S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively concerns land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains notices under Section 7 regarding the government's intention to acquire specific lands for public purposes, including detailed descriptions of the properties, acquisition procedures, deadlines for claims, and compensation processes. The content focuses entirely on land-related administrative procedures without involving government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other non-land matters.
